def prop_ci(vals, label, nboot=10000):
    valid=[v for v in vals if v not in ('-77','-99','')]
    n=len(valid)
    k=sum(1 for v in valid if v.lower()=='quoted')
    p=k/n
    boots=[]
    for _ in range(nboot):
        s=[random.choice(valid) for _ in range(n)]
        boots.append(sum(1 for v in s if v.lower()=='quoted')/n)
    boots.sort()
    lo=boots[int(0.025*nboot)]; hi=boots[int(0.975*nboot)-1]
    print(f"{label}: n_valid={n} k={k} p={p:.4f} CI=[{lo:.4f},{hi:.4f}]",
          f"se={(p*(1-p)/n)**0.5:.4f}", "wald=[%.4f,%.4f]"%((p-1.96*(p*(1-p)/n)**0.5),(p+1.96*(p*(1-p)/n)**0.5)))
    # also percentile of bootstrap mean
    return p, lo, hi, k, n

res={}
for c in cols:

# alternative denominator: all 276 rows
